how: C# moves, renames, reformatting and reorders on real same-file commits (practice: Polly, Newtonsoft.Json; held out: whole projects, totals only), labelled by reading each diff before any C# engine run, 2026-11-14, following harness/audit/AUDIT.md. A move that changes meaning (into or out of an #if branch, out of a containing class, an enum member reordered, a modifier changed) is a wrong plain-move claim; a rename that also changes another token is wrong for renamed.
